definitions.explanation: the temperature at which a liquid turns into a solid

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{凝固点|ぎょうこてん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{零度|れいど}→零度：27531_reido⟧だ。
examples.english: The freezing point of water is zero degrees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{凝固点|ぎょうこてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: Adding salt lowers the freezing point.

examples.japanese: {凝固点|ぎょうこてん}⟦{降下|こうか}→降下：21547_kouka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原理|げんり}→原理：00066_genri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}して→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧、⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{融雪剤|ゆうせつざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撒|ま}く→撒く：12711_maku⟧。
examples.english: Using the principle of freezing-point depression, de-icing agents are spread on winter roads.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{凝固|ぎょうこ}→凝固：08668_gyouko⟧ (solidification; coagulation) + ⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ (point). A scientific term commonly encountered in school chemistry and physics. The concept of {凝固点|ぎょうこてん}⟦{降下|こうか}→降下：21547_kouka⟧ (freezing-point depression) is a standard topic in Japanese science education.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {凝固点|ぎょうこてん}⟦{降下|こうか}→降下：21547_kouka⟧: freezing-point depression
- {凝固点|ぎょうこてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧: the freezing point drops
- {凝固点|ぎょうこてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}する→達する：02129_tassuru⟧: to reach the freezing point
- {凝固点|ぎょうこてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測定|そくてい}→測定：04398_sokutei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to measure the freezing point

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{融点|ゆうてん}→融点：21505_yuuten⟧: melting point — the temperature at which a solid becomes liquid (same temperature as the freezing point, viewed from the other direction)
- ⟦{沸点|ふってん}→沸点：25307_futten⟧: boiling point — the temperature at which a liquid becomes gas
- {氷点|ひょうてん}: freezing point (of water specifically) — more colloquial than {凝固点|ぎょうこてん}
